method: For each tx: chain_getBlockHash(recorded number) vs recorded hash; number <= finalized head; chain_getBlock and blake2-256 of every full extrinsic to find the tx; decode call and signer with state_getMetadata(at block); System.Events at the block filtered by ApplyExtrinsic(index); dispatch result from ExtrinsicSuccess/ExtrinsicFailed (module error decoded); then compare with the committed evidence.
